text:
Higgsfield Plugins elevate Premiere Pro & After Effects with Seedance 2.0.

Generate VFX/CGI, motion design, and cinematic shots in one prompt, then refine with Draw-to-Edit, reframe, upscale & background removal. 

Meet full production in Premiere Pro & After Effects. https://t.co/mXGKkDqM1c
content:
Generate VFX/CGI, motion design, and cinematic shots in Seedance 2.0 using a single prompt inside the Higgsfield Plugins for Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Refine Seedance 2.0 generations using Draw-to-Edit for targeted edits within Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Use reframe on Seedance 2.0 outputs to adjust composition/aspect inside Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Upscale Seedance 2.0 outputs to higher resolution within Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Apply background removal to Seedance 2.0 outputs to isolate subjects for compositing within Premiere Pro/After Effects

Refina las generaciones de Seedance 2.0 usando Draw-to-Edit para ediciones específicas dentro de Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Usa reframe en las salidas de Seedance 2.0 para ajustar la composición/aspecto dentro de Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Escala las salidas de Seedance 2.0 a una resolución más alta dentro de Premiere Pro/After Effects  
Aplica la eliminación de fondo a las salidas de Seedance 2.0 para aislar sujetos para composición dentro de Premiere Pro/After Effects
